listing.name: Chocolate Heretic
listing.summary: Play Heretic with the original game files, or try its shareware episode.

steps.title: Set up Heretic on Windows
steps.instruction: Choose the matching original Heretic IWAD or one of the listed demo editions. Portcove keeps your original file and prepares a separate copy for Play. Saved games are separate for each exact IWAD. Keep the same original with its saves; select a separate setup to change editions.

references.title: Linux and Mac installations you maintain
references.instruction: Install the chocolate-doom package through your Linux distribution or Homebrew on Mac, then select the chocolate-heretic player with its matching IWAD. The package manager owns runtime updates. Explicit registration keeps ownership of the player, originals and actual profile with you.

warnings: Keep saves with their creating game and runtime. Changing engines or game editions does not convert saved games.
A profile that points outside its local autoload or music-pack folders must be preserved and corrected before Play. Portcove does not rewrite existing settings.

source_requirements.label: Heretic PC IWAD (selected original or demo editions)
